entities.name: Sekena
entities.description: Dwarf from Tigaden in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia born with an inherent skill to bond with dragons.

entities.name: Tamun
entities.description: Sekena's sister, who later pledged herself to Reod Dai.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Wizard who bought dragon eggs from the dwarves.

entities.name: Tigaden
entities.description: Dwarven village in the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: Keep besieged by orcs and goblins and overwhelmed.

entities.name: Mount Shanin
entities.description: Mountain where Sekena met a fully-grown dragon.

entities.name: Teedmar
entities.description: City destroyed by a volcanic eruption.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Collapse that the newly forged family resolved to face.

events.summary: In the fourth year of egg harvesting Reod Dai refuses to pay; an egg hatches in the dwarves' basement and Reod destroys the hatchling and their house with an exploding spell.
events.quote: Reod Dai suddenly refused to pay the agreed-upon sum

events.summary: The dwarves join Reod north to dispose of the eggs; Sekena bonds with the dragons and takes two surviving whelps toward Teedmar.
events.quote: She brought two of the surviving whelps with her and headed towards Teedmar

events.summary: On Mount Shanin Sekena bonds with a fully-grown dragon and later finds her mother and sister chased by goblins; the dragon kills the goblins and she is reunited with her family.
events.quote: The dragon roasted the goblins and feasted on their corpses, while Sekena was reunited with her family.

events.summary: Sekena has the dragons fly to besieged Gurn Keep and rescue Tamun, herself and Reod Dai before the keep falls.
events.quote: Sekena ordered the dragons to fly to Gurn Keep

events.summary: Reod and Tamun pledge themselves to each other and the family resolves to face the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.
events.quote: Reod and Sekena's sister Tamun then pledged themselves to each other

relations.quote: Growing up with her sister Tamun and her mother Melelki
